pages.title: Saiga
pages.text: The saiga ($(o)Saiga tatarica$()) is an antelope of the dry steppes and semi-deserts of Central Asia, found today mainly in Kazakhstan, Russia and Mongolia.$(br2)Its most striking feature is a large, flexible, drooping nose, which filters out dust in summer and warms cold air in winter.$(br2)During the Pleistocene, saiga roamed the mammoth steppe from western Europe to Alaska.
